proposalGuidance: Keep ManagedToolId closed to openspec and archify.
Keep Node exact patch out of managed-tool authority; package.json engines.node remains host compatibility truth.
Constrain runtimeRoot and entrypoint beneath exact FLOWKIT_HOME/tools/<tool>/<version>; fail closed on traversal/escape.
Never silently fall back to PATH/global tools.
Return resolved identity only; leave invocation to later integration.
Treat artifact hashes as provenance/restore facts, not a new live directory-attestation subsystem.
